notes.title: RELEASE - LIVING CELL!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/3b5ea939f8fa4469af0a0e2014a1044f573c8f30.png

Hello everyone!
We are here with you - the Service Staff.
Just recently the release of our game "Living Cell" took place!
We are glad that you play and leave reviews on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/7b08d3767b002d6933109549b9ee3f5d2683dac6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/cca5cfaf571078445308b358bbba8b0ee944cf97.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/e0c3ac05fcbfd6338cac2700029f7425b4300001.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/38d098c5feeb19e06c38700daba33d97903a7e60.png

We continue to support our Living Cell and are constantly releasing updates with small fixes.
Very soon we will be releasing an artbook, desktop wallpapers and a soundtrack compilation based on our game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/2f3c5c093f51be229e6fa8e20bcca055077d2aed.png

Thanks to everyone who join us on the Discord server.

notes.title: Less than two hours away from the release!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/9c4819f4d1361c16185bd04bb275b242a8dff4e9.png

Hi!

We are just hours away from the release of our game!
The service staff (that's what we call our team) is very excited, hardly sleeps and wants everything to go perfectly! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/cca5cfaf571078445308b358bbba8b0ee944cf97.png

We have painted many locations, come up with puzzles and quests, added collectibles that you can collect as you play, and even localised posters and items! We've also added achievements to Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/38d098c5feeb19e06c38700daba33d97903a7e60.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/e0c3ac05fcbfd6338cac2700029f7425b4300001.png

We really need your support at the release!
We hope you enjoy Living Cell!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44186193/fd8768891c8ccc55b76d741e95a4140da4de7c36.gif

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2380310/_/
